deleteConfirmationDialog.title: Really delete data?
deleteConfirmationDialog.description: This will permanently delete your submitted building data from the $t(municipality:dataSubmission.server). Your local session and the downloaded PDF report will be kept.
deleteConfirmationDialog.checkingDescription: Please wait while we check whether the submitted data is still available.
deleteConfirmationDialog.unavailableDescription: This link is no longer valid or the submitted data is no longer available.
deleteConfirmationDialog.deletedDescription: Your submitted data has been permanently deleted from the $t(municipality:dataSubmission.server).
deleteConfirmationDialog.receiptDescription: Keep this deletion receipt secure. The complete receipt is required to prove the deletion of this specific submission later.
deleteConfirmationDialog.cancelledDescription: Your submitted data has not been deleted.
deleteConfirmationDialog.serviceErrorDescription: The deletion status could not be determined. Please try again.

invalidBuildingConfirmDialog.title: Select this building anyway?
invalidBuildingConfirmDialog.description: According to the available data, this building is not intended for the renovation tool. The calculation may therefore produce unsuitable or incomplete results. Would you still like to select it?

externalBuildingLink.invalidWarning: The external building link is incomplete or invalid.
externalBuildingLink.notFoundWarning: The requested building could not be found. If it is visible, you can select it manually.

renovationPotentialInfoDialog.title: How is this estimate determined?
renovationPotentialInfoDialog.description: The initial estimate is based exclusively on the known construction year. Buildings constructed through 1983 are assigned high potential, buildings from 1984 through 1994 moderate potential, and newer buildings a tendency toward lower renovation potential. The possible heritage-protection notice is shown when the construction year is unknown or is 1948 or earlier. In the following steps, you can review and supplement the building data. This estimate replaces neither professional energy advice nor verification of heritage status.

renovationPotential.title: Estimated Renovation Potential

descriptions.high: Based on the known construction year, the building is expected to have high energy-renovation potential.
descriptions.moderate: Based on the known construction year, the building is expected to have moderate energy-renovation potential.
descriptions.lower: Based on the known construction year, the building is expected to have low energy-renovation potential.
descriptions.unknown: No construction year is known for this building. Its energy-renovation potential can only be shown in a subsequent step.

renovationPotential.basis: Initial estimate based on the construction year {{year}}.
renovationPotential.assumption: The estimate is based on the assumption that no extensive renovation has taken place in the meantime.

heritageWarning.title: Possible heritage protection
heritageWarning.description: Special requirements may apply to older buildings. Before planning, please verify whether the building has protected heritage status.

buildingWindow.title: Initial Energy Assessment
buildingWindow.subtitle: Initial energy estimate based on public data and model assumptions. In the next step, you can review, supplement, or modify the building data.
buildingWindow.processingTime: Processing takes approximately 10 minutes to complete
